name: Casting & Solidification Processing
summary: Explains how molten metal is turned into shapes and how heat flow and solidification control the resulting microstructure and defects.

topics.name: Transport phenomena in processing: heat conduction, convection and fluid flow basics
Heat flow in casting: Chvorinov's rule and mould-metal interface
Solidification microstructures: chill, columnar and equiaxed zones; dendrite arm spacing
Segregation: Scheil equation, microsegregation and macrosegregation
Grain refinement and inoculation; eutectic modification
Casting processes: sand, investment, die, permanent mould and centrifugal casting
Continuous casting of steel and aluminium; ingot casting
Casting defects: shrinkage, gas porosity, hot tearing and inclusions
